# AngelScript 2.34.0
Retrieved from [codecat/angelscript-mirror](https://github.com/codecat/angelscript-mirror/tree/v2.34.0).
Repackaged from the release `sdk/` as `angelscript-2.34.0.tar.xz` (core `include/`,
`source/`, and `add_on/`). The build target is defined by `angelscript.cmake`,
since the upstream CMake project only exists under `projects/cmake`.
